<!-- Shared by findings.qmd and es/findings.qmd. Expects OJS variables `lang`, `root`. -->
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import { strings } from "/assets/strings.js"
import { split } from "/assets/catalog.js"
t = strings[lang]
papers = d3.json(root + "data/papers.json")
catalog = d3.json(root + "data/catalog.json")
themes = Object.keys(t.themeNames)
decade = y => y ? Math.floor(y / 10) * 10 : null

// Count every (a, b) pair where a and b are values of two (possibly
// multi-valued, ";"-separated) fields.
pairs = (rows, fa, fb) => {
  const m = d3.rollup(rows.flatMap(d => split(fa(d)).flatMap(a => split(fb(d)).map(b => [a, b]))),
                      v => v.length, p => p[0], p => p[1]);
  return [...m].flatMap(([a, inner]) => [...inner].map(([b, n]) => ({ a, b, n })));
}
heat = (data, xDomain, yDomain, yLabel) => Plot.plot({
  width: 1000, marginLeft: 240, marginBottom: 70, height: 28 * yDomain.length + 90,
  x: { domain: xDomain, label: null, tickRotate: -35 },
  y: { domain: yDomain, label: null, tickFormat: yLabel },
  color: { scheme: "greens", type: "sqrt" },
  marks: [
    Plot.cell(data, { x: "b", y: "a", fill: "n", inset: 0.5, tip: true }),
    Plot.text(data, { x: "b", y: "a", text: "n", fill: d => d.n > 25 ? "white" : "#1d2420", fontSize: 11 })
  ]
})
htl.html`<p class="lead-sm">${t.findingsIntro}</p>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
gap = themes.map(th => {
  const p = papers.filter(d => split(d.themes).includes(th)).length;
  const ds = catalog.filter(d => split(d.themes).includes(th)).length;
  return { theme: t.themeNames[th], papers: p, datasets: ds, ratio: p ? ds / p * 10 : 0 };
}).sort((a, b) => a.ratio - b.ratio)
htl.html`<h2>${t.evGapTitle}</h2><p>${t.evGapText}</p>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  width: 1000, marginLeft: 240, height: 340,
  x: { label: t.evGapAxis, grid: true },
  y: { domain: gap.map(d => d.theme), label: null },
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(gap, { y: "theme", x: "ratio", fill: "#b5793e", tip: true,
                     title: d => `${d.theme}\n${d.papers} ${t.paperResults} · ${d.datasets} ${t.results}` }),
    Plot.text(gap, { y: "theme", x: "ratio", text: d => `${d.papers} · ${d.datasets}`, dx: 6, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 11 }),
    Plot.ruleX([0])
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
withSector = papers.filter(d => split(d.sectors).length)
sectorData = pairs(withSector, d => d.themes, d => d.sectors)
sectorOrder = d3.groupSort(sectorData, v => -d3.sum(v, d => d.n), d => d.b)
htl.html`<h2>${t.evSectorTitle}</h2><p>${t.evSectorText.replace("{n}", withSector.length).replace("{total}", papers.length)}</p>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
heat(sectorData, sectorOrder, themes, d => t.themeNames[d])
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
decadeData = pairs(papers, d => d.themes, d => d.year ? String(decade(d.year)) + "s" : "")
decades = [...new Set(papers.map(d => decade(d.year)).filter(Boolean))].sort().map(d => d + "s")
htl.html`<h2>${t.evDecadeTitle}</h2><p>${t.evDecadeText}</p>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
heat(decadeData, decades, themes, d => t.themeNames[d])
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
taxaData = pairs(papers, d => d.taxa, d => d.themes)
taxaOrder = d3.groupSort(taxaData, v => -d3.sum(v, d => d.n), d => d.a).slice(0, 16)
htl.html`<h2>${t.evTaxaTitle}</h2><p>${t.evTaxaText}</p>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
heat(taxaData.filter(d => taxaOrder.includes(d.a)).map(d => ({ a: d.a, b: t.themeNames[d.b], n: d.n })),
     themes.map(th => t.themeNames[th]), taxaOrder, d => d)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
htl.html`<p class="photo-note">${t.evNote}</p>`
```
